regions.physical_reason: bitcell_array is the dominant regular storage block and anchors the SRAM floorplan.
dummy_array sits on the physical boundary of the storage core to preserve edge-related context.
replica_array is placed near the array/column edge to preserve later timing and replica-path meaning.
row path modules sit on one side of the array and anchor to row-pitch ownership.
column path modules sit above the array and follow column ownership.
control modules remain in a dedicated periphery region rather than scattering through the array.
R4 needs a stable routing channel between array and column periphery.
R4 needs perimeter room for top-level power distribution.
